own_solution.law: Steady current I = emf/R1 (the zero-resistance solenoid shorts the second resistor); long-solenoid L = mu0 N^2 pi r^2 / l; all stored energy (1/2) L I^2 is dissipated in the second resistor
assumptions: switch opens instantly, no other dissipation or radiation

notes: Claims match pass 1. L = 1.4216e-3 H; base 0.5*L*9 = 6.397 mJ. R answers: 15.2 V -> I = 3.8 A -> 10.264 mJ; 19.5 V -> 4.875 A -> 16.893 mJ; 23 V -> 5.75 A -> 23.501 mJ, all correct. The C cancellation of R2 (integral of I0^2 R exp(-2Rt/L) dt = L I0^2 / 2) is correct. Minimal pairs T8F98/T000E and T200B/T0F51 share 7.5 V and differ only in attachment; T212D and TC1E1 are declared numeral-free twins.
